'''Harlal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Vice-Commandant]] of the [[InterStellar Regulators]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was among those who were bought off by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] prior to the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. However, as the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] came dangerously close to destruction, Regulators found less and less reasons to remain on the surface. Harlal and the others were paid extra by the [[Archon (Hutt)|Archon]] [[Szajin]] to stay even as most of the civilian and Republic forces were evacuated. Szajin promised to prove that Makeb was stabilized, but was confronted and defeated by the Imperial hero who worked with [[Katha Niar]] to save the planet.<ref name="Revenge of the Archon" />

{{GameDS}}
To prevent the Regulators leaking information about the Empire's involvement, they used their laser drills to bury the mercenaries in magma and rubble, leaving Harlal's fate unclear.<ref name="Revenge of the Archon" />
{{Endgame}}
